name: Epitome
storyline:
In the beginning,

There was only the void and Zethar, a powerful Archon, alone in infinity. Craving companionship, he attempted to create life, but the soulless beings he formed were fleeting and insubstantial. Realizing that something was missing, Zethar sacrificed half of his power and devised a grand system - Epitome - that would give souls a place to exist and thrive.

He invited ten souls from another universe - to nurture these new souls, Zethar created M1 - the Land of Beginnings - where new souls could start their journey. As the guardian of this world, Zethar watched with hope as life began to unfold in the world he had created.

After swiftly transforming into Archons and quickly becoming powerful, their lust for power began to threaten the balance of the universe.

The Land of Beginnings is a reflection of Zethar's original vision - a realm full of life, natural energy, and balance. This is where you as well begin your long and unforgettable journey, which may eventually lead to achieving the status of an Archon and uncovering the mysteries of existence.

For an ordinary mortal, these mysteries remain inaccessible, buried deep in the annals of history. However, for those who dare to approach the gates of the unknown and cross the boundaries of what seems impossible, the reward may be an inexhaustible source of knowledge and power that others never had the chance to experience.
summary:
Welcome to the system of Epitome. Explore a world woven from the threads of reality.
Here, us, the Archons, my creations, rule over their unique realms, shaping and disorting them according to their desires.This is no mere adventure - enter Epitome and strive to become an Archon.
